title: Exceptional loci of F-blowups and $G$-Hilbert schemes
summary: We study exceptional loci of F-blowups of normal toric varieties. In the $\Q$-factorial case, this study amounts to studying the exceptional loci of $G$-Hilbert schemes. We give a formula for the dimension of the center of a prime divisor on the F-blowup in terms of combinatorial data, together with an algorithm for computing it. Moreover, we study the relation between F-blowups and essential divisors for three-dimensional terminal singularities and canonical singularities.
